title: Create a User Profile
description: Add a profile model with extra fields and create it automatically when a user is created.
problemStatement:
## Your Mission

Create a `Profile` model with fields:
- `user` (OneToOneField to User)
- `bio` (TextField, blank)
- `birth_date` (DateField, null, blank)

Write a signal that automatically creates a profile whenever a new user is created. Also, update the profile when the user is saved.

Test by creating a user in the Django shell and verifying that a profile exists.
hints: Use `from django.db.models.signals import post_save` and `@receiver(post_save, sender=User)`.
In the signal, call `Profile.objects.create(user=instance)` if created is True.
Don't forget to connect the signal in `apps.py` or import the signals in the app's `ready()` method.
expectedOutput: After creating a user, a profile record is automatically created with no extra fields (blank).
